title: The Four Thieves
coreMove: Identify the recurring threats that steal protected focus and build defenses before they enter the room.
sourcePressure: Part 3 identifies recurring thieves that remove time, structure, or attention from the chosen path and asks for practical defenses instead of paranoia.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning obstacles into vague anxiety, blame, or a made-up canonical list.

hook: A single choice changes the whole day
The real priority is hiding under the busy work
The Four Thieves as a generic focus opener
counterintuition: Focus is harder than it looks
tryThisNow: Set a timer and list priorities
Write down your one thing without a concrete context
examples: generic office worker choosing email or strategy

exampleSpecs.stakes: eligible patients are missed when interruptions scatter the call window
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she marks the interruption source, moves consent calls behind a closed clinic door, and places a paper sign before dialing
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a consent script under a closed clinic-room sign at 9:00 a.m.

exampleSpecs.stakes: walk-in favors keep breaking the color calibration block
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he names walk-in favors as the thief and gives the front desk a red card rule during calibration
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a red card clipped to a press console beside cyan test strips

exampleSpecs.stakes: small requests erase the only scanning window
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she sets a public request basket for later and scans the oldest deed books before opening the counter window
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a cracked deed book on a flatbed scanner before the counter gate lifts

exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he sees committee email is the thief and leaves the reed case on the stand while the laptop stays in another room
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an oboe reed case open on a music stand under a single lamp

exampleSpecs.stakes: urgent chat pings prevent fixing duplicate client records
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she predicts pings are unavoidable, then reroutes them for ninety minutes and watches duplicate records finally disappear
exampleSpecs.firstImage: two duplicate client records highlighted on a database screen

exampleSpecs.stakes: late menu tweaks threaten the delivery route
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the team identifies last-minute taste changes as the thief and freezes the menu before loading the van
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a sealed menu packet taped inside a catering van door

tryThisNowSpec: Name the one thief most likely to steal tomorrow's priority and place one visible defense before the work begins.
